reply.text:
Yes, normal muscle soreness from training is fine to train through, and a lot of lifters do. A good test is to warm up properly and see how the first couple of sets feel. If the soreness eases as you move and your lifts feel close to normal, carry on. If you're dragging, trim a set or two or take the weight down a notch, or train a different body part that day.

Sharp pain, pain in a joint, or soreness that hasn't improved after several days is a different thing. That one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach.

If you'd like a lighter session today, tell me and I'll set one up.
